labels.label: T-abs-hoist-model-free/exists_minimal_of_isCompact
labels.notes: No paper label is certified and no module docstring carries a mark. Causal.Causality.exists_minimal_of_isCompact moved from Causal.CBG.NoCorresponding to Causal.CompactMinimal. Its type, universe parameters and full binder telescope (names and binder infos) are identical before and after on the compiled environment. Its Zorn proof is replaced by a derivation from exists_minimal_of_isCompact_on at W = ⊤, as documented. exists_minimal_of_isCompact_on was moved from Causal.NestedCausalities and is byte-identical to HEAD (Nested.old:1286-1334 = CompactMinimal:61-109). It is kept because it is more general (any open W, J⁻_W(x) closed only inside K, conclusion J⁻_W(p) ∩ K = {p}, which implies the W = ⊤ form), and that is correct. Axioms: standard. The Sbierski binder's Causal.Causality.exists_minimal_of_isCompact still resolves. lean-gx's positional calls (GX/BTZ/AbsMax.lean:229, Spear.lean:1585) see an unchanged signature.
